description: 5 Whys Root Cause Analysis — AI 5 Whys root-cause analysis: one causal chain (3-5 whys) with each link marked fact or assumption plus the evidence to check, root cause and type, confidence, countermeasures tagged contain/correct/prevent with owner role and how to verify, alternative branches and open questions. Offline quality checks flag blame-style root causes (human error), assumption-heavy chains, missing prevention and shallow chains. Includes markdown. Param problem=, optional context= (facts, timeline). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

problem.description: e.g. Checkout error rate jumped to 8% after Tuesday's deploy
